en: A black-and-white image of a medieval stone complex with a square tower in the left foreground and a round double-tower structure in the background. The buildings have steep, tiled roofs, and the nearer tower has a small lantern on top. A stone curtain wall with arched openings runs from the right foreground toward the towers, with a narrow path beside it. Trees and low vegetation surround the structures, giving the impression of a castle or fortified estate on a hill. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.
